description_en: Pause an Intelligent Contact Robot calling job that has been successfully started
description_zh: 暂停已成功启动的智能联络机器人呼叫任务
name: StopTask

parameters.help_en: The unique job ID of the robot calling task. You can view it on the Task Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list) page or obtain it by using the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html API.
parameters.help_zh: 机器人呼叫任务的唯一任务ID。在任务管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list)页面查看或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html接口获取
parameters.name: task_id

Code.description_en: The request status code. A value of OK indicates that the request succeeded.
Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。返回OK代表请求成功

false: Failed.
